reasoning_content: It's installed but the path isn't set correctly. Let me fix the environment:

action.command:
python3 << 'EOF'
import paramiko
c = paramiko.SSHClient()
c.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
c.connect('46.202.154.25', 22, 'root', '2N00py123+++')

# Set proper environment
c.exec_command("""echo 'export JAVA_HOME=/usr/lib/jvm/java-17-openjdk-amd64' > /etc/profile.d/java17.sh
echo 'export PATH=\\$JAVA_HOME/bin:\$PATH' >> /etc/profile.d/java17.sh
chmod +x /etc/profile.d/java17.sh""")

# Source it
c.exec_command("source /etc/profile.d/java17.sh && java -version")

print("Java ready!")

c.close()
EOF
